title: James Hardie Celebrates World Habitat Day with Renewed Support for Affordable Housing Through Habitat for Humanity Initiatives
summary: James Hardie Building Products Inc. proudly announces its continued commitment to affordable housing and climate-resilient communities through its sponsorship of Habitat for Humanity's 2025 Jimmy & Rosalynn Carter Work Project and ongoing Habitat Strong efforts.
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO, Oct. 6, 2025 /PRNewswire/** -- On this World Habitat Day, James Hardie Building Products Inc. (James Hardie), a subsidiary of James Hardie Industries plc (ASX: JHX; NYSE:[JHX](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/james-hardie-celebrates-world-habitat-day-with-renewed-support-for-affordable-housing-through-habitat-for-humanity-initiatives-302576174.html?tc=eml_cleartime#financial-modal) ) and a leading provider of exterior design solutions, proudly announces its continued commitment to affordable housing and climate-resilient communities through its sponsorship of Habitat for Humanity's 2025 Jimmy & Rosalynn Carter Work Project and ongoing Habitat Strong efforts.


This year's celebration underscores James Hardie's commitment to our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™, by creating lasting impact in neighborhoods across the country. With a deep focus on sustainable, resilient, and affordable housing, the initiative aims to empower families and communities while advancing solutions to one of the world's most pressing housing challenges.


## **Supporting the 2025 Carter Work Project**


James Hardie is honored to be a sponsor of Habitat for Humanity's 2025 Jimmy & Rosalynn Carter Work Project, taking place in Austin, Texas. This flagship event represents Habitat for Humanity's mission of bringing people together to build homes, communities, and hope, while focusing on the urgent need for affordable housing. As a Dream Maker sponsor, James Hardie will support the construction of safe and affordable homes in Austin and contribute to the project's larger goal of uplifting the lives of homeowners who face housing insecurity. The company will also engage its employees as volunteers, further deepening its impact on the local community.


## **Habitat Strong: Building Resilient Futures**


James Hardie continues to sponsor the development of climate-resilient housing as part of their Habitat Strong focus. Habitat Strong, an initiative within Habitat for Humanity, emphasizes constructing homes that withstand extreme weather events while maintaining affordability and energy efficiency. Durable Hardie® products play a critical role in these builds because they are noncombustible* and resilient against moisture, pests, and severe weather. Together with Habitat, the company is helping families not only thrive in their homes but also helps prepare for the impacts of climate change.


## **The James Hardie™ Pro Football Hall of Fame Invitational: A Legacy of Giving Back**


In addition to its corporate sponsorships, James Hardie is proud of the contributions made through its annual James Hardie™ Pro Football Hall of Fame Invitational event. Habitat for Humanity was a cornerstone charity partner of the inaugural 2025 Invitational, which raised significant funds to support Habitat for Humanity's work. The fundraising efforts of the Invitational have made lasting impacts, including the construction of a home built in collaboration with the Pro Football Hall of Fame in Canton, Ohio, in 2024. The positive momentum continues as James Hardie looks forward to next year's Invitational and its anticipated contributions to affordable housing initiatives.


For more information about James Hardie's support of Habitat for Humanity International and the 'Habitat Strong' program or the company's products, visit[JamesHardie.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4526619-1&h=847742127&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4189831-1%26h%3D688158116%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fc212.net%252Fc%252Flink%252F%253Ft%253D0%2526l%253Den%2526o%253D4098580-1%2526h%253D3806610253%2526u%253Dhttp%25253A%25252F%25252Fwww.jameshardie.com%25252F%2526a%253Dwww.jameshardie.com%26a%3DJamesHardie.com&a=JamesHardie.com) .


**Hardie* *®* *fiber cement products are noncombustible and/or have a Class A fire rating when tested in accordance with ASTM E84. Fiber cement fire resistance does not extend to applied paints or coatings, which may be damaged or char when exposed to flames. The use of noncombustible* siding, combined with other fire mitigation measures, may help harden a home against external fire.*


## **About James Hardie**


James Hardie Building Products Inc. is a subsidiary of James Hardie Industries plc (ASX: JHX; NYSE:[JHX](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/james-hardie-celebrates-world-habitat-day-with-renewed-support-for-affordable-housing-through-habitat-for-humanity-initiatives-302576174.html?tc=eml_cleartime#financial-modal) ) (JHI) which is the industry leader in exterior home and outdoor living solutions, with a portfolio that includes fiber cement, fiber gypsum, composite and PVC decking and railing products. Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®.


With over 8,000 employees, JHI boasts 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we're united by our purpose of **Building a Better Future for All™** through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities.

#### **About Habitat for Humanity**


Habitat for Humanity is a movement of people in your local area and around the world, working together to build more prosperous and vibrant communities by making sure everyone has a safe, affordable place to call home. Since our founding in 1976 as a Christian organization, together we have helped more than 62 million people globally build their futures on their own terms through access to decent housing. We've done that by working alongside people of all walks of life to build, repair and finance their homes, by innovating new ways of building and financing, and by advocating for policies that make constructing and accessing housing easier for everyone. Together, we build homes, communities and hope. To learn more, visit habitat.org
